articles.title: Angel Reese, Gabby Williams + Two Stunning Sweeps Set the WNBA Finals | Chiney Today
articles.summary: BRING OUT THE BROOMS! 🧹🏀 The WNBA Finals are SET, and the Atlanta Dream and Golden State Valkyries are heading to the Finals after two stunning semifinal sweeps!
body: On this special episode of Chiney Today, Chiney Ogwumike is joined by her friend and ESPN Senior Researcher Jason Joseph (JayJo) to break down an unforgettable night of WNBA playoff basketball!

Angel Reese and the Atlanta Dream are headed to their first WNBA Finals since 2013 after sweeping the New York Liberty! Chiney and JayJo discuss Angel's impact on Atlanta, her improved three-point shooting, Jordin Canada's outstanding postseason, and how DeWanna Bonner helped the Dream overcome injuries to reach the championship stage.

Meanwhile, the Golden State Valkyries make history in just their SECOND season as a franchise! After sweeping A'ja Wilson and the defending champs Las Vegas Aces, Golden State is headed to its first WNBA Finals. Chiney breaks down Gabby Williams' emergence, Kiah Stokes' incredible defense against A'ja Wilson, and Head Coach Natalie Nakase's game plan against her former team.
